title: The Last Leaf of Autumn
author: Hamidreza Rostami
short_description: A leaf learns that letting go can be beautiful.
long_description: Rustle loves his branch high in the maple tree, but as autumn arrives, all the other leaves are changing color and falling to the ground. Rustle clings tightly, afraid of letting go. But as he watches the world below and listens to the wind's gentle wisdom, he begins to understand that falling isn't the end—it's the beginning of something new. When he finally lets go, he discovers the joy of dancing on the wind and joining the colorful carpet of leaves below. A poetic story about change, acceptance, and the beauty of new beginnings.
